# Venera Academy Dilsukhnagar

> A beauty training institute in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, offering certified
> professional courses in makeup artistry, hair styling, skin care, cosmetology,
> nail art and beautician skills, with 100% practical training and placement support.

## Key facts

- **Full name:** Venera Academy Dilsukhnagar
- **Type:** Beauty training institute / vocational academy
- **City:** Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- **Address:** 5th Floor, 16-2-740/15, Plot No 51, Andrabank Colony, above SBI Bank, Malakpet, Hyderabad, Telangana 500036
- **Tagline:** The Signature of Beauty
- **Phone:** +91 91607 21000, +91 90520 89000
- **Email:** info@veneraacademy.in
- **Opening hours:** Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM. Closed Sunday.
- **Languages of instruction:** English, Telugu, Hindi
- **Website:** https://www.venera-academy.com/

## Courses offered

- [Makeup Artist Course](https://www.venera-academy.com/makeup-artist.html): Bridal, HD, party, fashion and airbrush makeup, taught hands-on on real models.
- [Hair Styling & Hairdressing Course](https://www.venera-academy.com/hair-stylist.html): Cutting, coloring, keratin treatments and advanced styling.
- [Cosmetology Course](https://www.venera-academy.com/cosmetologist.html): Skin, hair, makeup, beauty services and salon management.
- [Beautician Course](https://www.venera-academy.com/beautician.html): Facials, waxing, threading, grooming and basic makeup. Beginner friendly.
- [Nail Art & Nail Extensions Course](https://www.venera-academy.com/nail.html): Gel nails, acrylic extensions and trending nail designs.
- [Skin Specialist Course](https://www.venera-academy.com/skin-specialist.html): Facials, skin analysis, treatments and advanced skin therapies.

## Course levels

Courses are offered at three levels, as set out in the academy brochure:

- **Makeup:** Foundation Course in Makeup Artistry; Certificate Course in Advanced Makeup Artistry.
- **Hair:** Foundation Course in Hair Dressing; Certificate Course in Advanced Hair Design; Advanced Course in Hairstyle Artistry.
- **Skin & Beauty Therapy:** Foundation Course in Beauty; Certificate Course in Advanced Beauty Therapy (four modules plus electrology).
- **Cosmetology:** Certificate Course in Advanced Cosmetology, covering skincare, haircare, makeup, grooming and beauty wellness.
- **Nails:** Nail Technician Course, 1 month duration.

## Short term courses

Mehendi; saree draping (pleating, box folding, korvai pleating); nail art; nail extensions; hydra facial; bolal massage; airbrush; threading; personality development; haircuts.

Saree draping specialisation covers North Indian, South Indian, Muslim, Bengali and Marathi bride draping, prepleating and corset pleating, plus add-ons: Instagram reel making and photoshoot, freelancing tips and a portfolio shoot.

## Common questions

- **Who can join?** Anyone. Courses are designed for beginners and aspiring beauty professionals; no prior experience is required.
- **How long are the courses?** Batches are flexible. Most students finish within 1–3 months depending on the modules chosen. The Nail Technician Course runs for 1 month.
- **Is the training practical?** Yes — 100% practical, with hands-on sessions on real models using premium international products.
- **Is a certificate provided?** Yes. Students receive a recognized certification on successful completion.
- **Is placement support offered?** Yes — job assistance with leading salons, plus portfolio and interview preparation.
- **Where is the academy located?** Dilsukhnagar, Hyderabad, easily reachable from across the city.
